name: Cross-Platform Mobile App (Offline-First Sync)
description: Robust mobile application (React Native / Flutter / Kotlin Multiplatform) with local-first database persistence, automatic background conflict resolution, outbox mutation queue, and optimistic UI updates.

clarifying_questions.question: Mobile development framework?
clarifying_questions.impacts: Sets build toolchain, navigation library, and state management libraries

clarifying_questions.question: Sync conflict resolution strategy?
clarifying_questions.impacts: Adds revision vectors and merge resolver logic

clarifying_questions.question: Push notification integration?
clarifying_questions.impacts: Configures background message handlers and device token registration

known_failure_modes: Failing to queue actions when internet connectivity drops mid-mutation resulting in lost user edits
Infinite retry loops on 4xx validation errors crashing the background sync worker
Unsynchronized clock drift causing Last-Write-Wins timestamps to overwrite newer data — use Lamport timestamps or server-coordinated sync tokens
